institution: CEI — Centro de Estudios de Innovación (escuela privada de diseño y tecnología, grupo Omnes Education; sedes Madrid, Sevilla, Valencia)
programme_name: Máster en Big Data e Inteligencia Artificial (IA)
official_status: título propio (school's own certificate). Page offers a paid add-on 'diploma universitario' from UDIMA or Sabal University (Florida); NOT a máster universitario oficial in its own right
start_date_verbatim: «Existen cuatro convocatorias o fechas de inicio anuales: Octubre, Enero, Abril y Junio.» — «Próximo inicio (entre semana): 13 de octubre de 2026 o 18 de enero de 2027»
application_deadline_for_spring_intake: NOT FOUND — page states rolling admission by convocatoria, no published closing date
modality: 100% presencial, 100% online o blended (Madrid, Sevilla, Valencia); online classes delivered live and recorded
tuition_total_eur: EUR 4,250 (matrícula incluida) — rates as displayed August 2026; discounts up to 40% advertised
evidence_verbatim: Existen cuatro convocatorias o fechas de inicio anuales: Octubre, Enero, Abril y Junio. / Próximo inicio (entre semana): 13 de octubre de 2026 o 18 de enero de 2027. / 360 horas (6-7 meses).
notes: PROVIDER TYPE THE OTHER SLICES WOULD MISS: private design/tech academy, not a university and not a business school. The four dated intakes are genuine COHORT STARTS (the page prints an actual start date, 18 Jan 2027), not application rounds. Título propio — no PhD access, no public funding, and the 300-ECTS advanced-standing question is moot. Short (6-7 month, 360h) format, so this is a reskilling certificate rather than a 60-90 ECTS master. Not among the 93 institutions in output/programmes.jsonl.

institution: ESIC University / ESIC Business & Marketing School (Madrid, Barcelona, Zaragoza, Málaga, Bilbao, Granada)
programme_name: Máster en Big Data, Business Analytics e Inteligencia Artificial (MBDA)
official_status: título propio — the page names it a «Máster de Formación Permanente» issued by ESIC University, which under RD 822/2021 is the legal name for a título propio, not a máster universitario oficial
start_date_verbatim: Programme page start-date selector shows «Oct. 2026» for every campus (Madrid Oct 2026 – Nov 2027). The only February string on the page is a stale «Feb. 2020» archival entry.
tuition_total_eur: EUR 18,250 Madrid / 18,400 Barcelona / 15,400 Zaragoza / 15,400 Málaga / 15,100 Bilbao / 15,400 Granada — as displayed August 2026
evidence_verbatim: Oct. 2026 (start date shown for Madrid, Barcelona, Zaragoza, Málaga, Bilbao, Granada). Máster de Formación Permanente por ESIC University.
notes: TRAP CAUGHT. A search-index summary asserted ESIC runs a «convocatoria de febrero» with scholarships for this master. The institution's own page contradicts it: a single October cohort start, and the only February token on the page is a 2020 leftover. Recorded NO on the strength of the primary page. Marketing 'convocatoria' language for ESIC refers to scholarship/application rounds, not cohort starts.
